newsHighlights.title: German president plays ping-pong at PKU
newsHighlights.summary: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier visited Peking University and played friendly table tennis matches with students and faculty at the Khoo Teck Puat Gymnasium on Oct 29.
newsHighlights.translation: 10月29日，德国总统施泰因迈尔访问北京大学，并在邱德拔体育馆与北大师生进行了友好的乒乓球友谊赛。

newsHighlights.title: Xi holds talks with German president
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping held talks with German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, calling for closer cultural and people-to-people exchanges between the two countries.
newsHighlights.translation: 国家主席习近平同德国总统施泰因迈尔举行会谈，呼吁两国进一步加强人文与民间交流。

newsHighlights.title: Business representatives discover opportunities in Linyi
newsHighlights.summary: Overseas business representatives visited Linyi in Shandong province and discovered new trade and investment opportunities in the city's markets and logistics hubs.
newsHighlights.translation: 海外商务代表走进山东临沂，在当地的市场与物流枢纽中发现了新的贸易与投资机遇。

newsHighlights.title: Peaceful reunification positive for Taiwan youth
newsHighlights.summary: Experts said that peaceful reunification would bring more study, work and travel opportunities for young people across the Taiwan Strait.
newsHighlights.translation: 专家表示，和平统一将为海峡两岸青年带来更多求学、就业与出行的机会。

newsHighlights.title: UAE says environmental cleanup operations continue along affected coastlines
newsHighlights.summary: The United Arab Emirates said cleanup operations are continuing along affected coastlines to protect beaches and marine life.
newsHighlights.translation: 阿联酋方面表示，受影响海岸线的清理工作仍在继续，以保护海滩与海洋生物。

quote.quote: The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page.
quote.author: Saint Augustine
quote.translation: 世界是一本书，不旅行的人只读了其中一页。
quote.explanation: 这句话把世界比作一本大书，强调旅行与文化交流能让人获得书本上学不到的知识。正如德国总统走进北大校园、海外商人走进临沂市场，亲身的到访与互动，往往比任何文字都更能增进理解。

vocabulary.example: The president played friendly table tennis matches with students at the Khoo Teck Puat Gymnasium.
vocabulary.translation: 总统在邱德拔体育馆与学生们进行了友好的乒乓球比赛。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily 报道《German president plays ping-pong at PKU》中的 "the Khoo Teck Puat Gymnasium"。

vocabulary.example: He played table tennis with students and faculty during his campus visit.
vocabulary.translation: 他在校园访问期间与学生和教工一起打乒乓球。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《German president plays ping-pong at PKU》中的 "played friendly table tennis matches with students and faculty"。

vocabulary.example: The two leaders called for closer cultural and people-to-people exchanges.
vocabulary.translation: 两位领导人呼吁加强文化与民间交流。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Xi holds talks with German president》中关于加强双边人文交流的表述。

vocabulary.example: Visiting business representatives discovered new opportunities in Linyi's markets and logistics hubs.
vocabulary.translation: 来访的商务代表在临沂的市场和物流枢纽发现了新机遇。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Business representatives discover opportunities in Linyi》标题与正文。

vocabulary.example: Peaceful reunification would be positive for young people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait.
vocabulary.translation: 和平统一对海峡两岸年轻人具有积极意义。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Peaceful reunification positive for Taiwan youth》。

vocabulary.example: Cleanup operations continue along the affected coastlines to protect beaches and marine life.
vocabulary.translation: 清理工作在受影响的海岸线持续进行，以保护海滩和海洋生物。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 快讯 "UAE says environmental cleanup operations continue along affected coastlines"。

vocabulary.example: The three countries cracked a major transnational case through trilateral cooperation.
vocabulary.translation: 三国通过三方合作破获了一起重大跨国案件。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Trilateral cooperation helps bust major drug ring》中的 "a major transnational drug manufacturing and trafficking case"。

vocabulary.definition: 非法交易，走私（尤指毒品、人口）
vocabulary.example: Joint operations can help prevent cross-border trafficking and protect travelers.
vocabulary.translation: 联合行动有助于打击跨境走私，保护出行人员的安全。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily《Trilateral cooperation helps bust major drug ring》中的 "drug manufacturing and trafficking case"。

vocabulary.example: Hong Kong announced reforms to strengthen the crackdown on graft in building works.
vocabulary.translation: 香港宣布改革措施，加大对建筑工程贪腐行为的打击力度。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 ChinaDaily《HK reforms to restrain graft in building works》中关于加强监管与整治的表述。

vocabulary.definition: 外交的；有手腕的，得体的
vocabulary.example: The president's campus tour was seen as a warm diplomatic gesture toward Chinese youth.
vocabulary.translation: 总统的校园之行被视为向中国青年传递善意的外交姿态。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联 ChinaDaily《German president plays ping-pong at PKU》与《Xi holds talks with German president》中的高层交往活动。

pattern.pattern: On + 日期, 主语 + visited + 地点 + and + 过去式动词 + with + 人物（用于描述一次访问、旅行或文化交流活动）
pattern.example: On Oct 29, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier visited Peking University and played friendly table tennis matches with students and faculty.
pattern.translation: 10月29日，德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔访问北京大学，并与师生进行了友好的乒乓球比赛。
pattern.usage: 这是新闻英语中描述"到访+活动"最常用的叙事框架。写作时先用 On + 时间 点明背景，再用 visited 引出地点，用 and 连接具体的活动细节，最后用 with 引出互动对象。旅行日记、游记、校园活动报道均可套用，例如：On Oct 20, our class visited the city museum and joined a guided tour with local volunteers.

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）：强调已经发生且与现在相关的事件
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时由 have/has + 过去分词 构成。新闻报道中常用它来陈述"刚刚完成、结果仍然有效"的事实，既说明事件已发生，又强调其对当下的影响。常与 already, just, so far, jointly, recently 等时间副词连用。若主语是三个并列的机构或国家，谓语仍用复数 have。
examples: Chinese, Indonesian and Malaysian anti-drug authorities have jointly cracked a major transnational drug manufacturing and trafficking case.
Business representatives from abroad have discovered new opportunities in Linyi's markets and logistics hubs.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第三个音节 /neɪ/ 上，读作 jim-NAY-zee-um。开头 /dʒ/ 类似汉语拼音的"j"，但声带振动更充分；注意 -sium 发 /ziəm/ 而不是 /ʃəm/。整词共 4 个音节，前面两个音节要读得轻而快，把声音的"高峰"留给 /neɪ/。
examples: The students welcomed the guests at the Khoo Teck Puat Gymnasium.
Our school gymnasium is open to visitors during the sports festival.

reading.title: Cultural Travel: When a Ping-Pong Rally Opens a Door
reading.content:
On Oct 29, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier visited Peking University and played friendly table tennis matches with students and faculty at the Khoo Teck Puat Gymnasium. The rally across the net reminded many people of the "ping-pong diplomacy" of the 1970s, when small sporting gestures opened the door to big conversations between nations.

Cultural travel is not only about sightseeing. Campus visits, language learning and youth dialogue give young people a chance to see the world from a different angle. In Linyi, Shandong province, business representatives from abroad discovered new opportunities in a city famous for its markets and logistics. Along the UAE coastline, cleanup work continues so that future travelers can still enjoy clean beaches.

Travel teaches what textbooks cannot. A handshake, a rally, or a walk through a strange city can build trust faster than any speech. That is the true value of cultural travel: it turns strangers into partners.
reading.translation:
10月29日，德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔访问北京大学，并在邱德拔体育馆与北大师生进行了友好的乒乓球比赛。球网两侧的来回对攻让许多人想起上世纪70年代的"乒乓外交"——小小的体育互动为国家之间的大对话打开了大门。

文化旅行不只是观光。校园访问、语言学习和青年对话，让年轻人有机会从不同的角度看世界。在山东临沂，来自海外的商务代表在一座以市场和物流闻名的城市里发现了新机遇。在阿联酋海岸线，清理工作仍在继续，好让未来的旅行者依然能享受洁净的海滩。

旅行能教会书本教不了的东西。一次握手、一局对打，或是在陌生城市的一次漫步，都比任何演讲更快地建立信任。这正是文化旅行的真正价值：它把陌生人变成伙伴。
reading.sourceNote: 本文根据 2026年10月31日 ChinaDaily《German president plays ping-pong at PKU》《Business representatives discover opportunities in Linyi》及 CGTN 关于阿联酋海岸线清理工作的报道改写，为学习目的进行了语言简化与整合。
